name: Lena Hoffmann
summary: Test engineer turned team lead who calibrates IMU sensors and offered help with sensor calibration and sensor fusion.

notes.text: Met Lena Hoffmann on my last week of the internship at Kessler Sensortechnik in Stuttgart. She's a test engineer in the inertial sensors group and spends most of her day calibrating IMU sensors (accelerometer + gyro bias, temperature compensation). Super patient explaining things. Said if I ever need help with sensor calibration for a uni project I should just message her. Into bouldering, goes to a gym in Bad Cannstatt every Thursday.

Subject: Re: greetings from California

Hi Felix,

nice to hear from you! Yes, I'm still at Kessler, now leading a small team for the new automotive IMU line. If your project needs sensor fusion (Kalman filter stuff) I'm happy to do a call, just not in March, we have an audit. By the way, Lisa from HR asked about you, they are opening working student positions in summer.

Best,
Lena
